chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn ash-Shah narrated that Abu Hamid quoted Abu Yazid Ahmad ibn Khalid al-Khalidy, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Salih al-Tamimy, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Hatam al-Qat'tan, on the authority of Hammad ibn Amr, on the authority of Ja'far ibn Muhammad, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said to Salman al-Farsi (may God be pleased with him):

O Salman! When you become sick, you gain three things: 1- You continually remember God., 2- Your prayers are accepted., and 3- All your sins are pardoned due to that ailment. May God give you good health up to the time of your death.
ai.seo_question: What are the three spiritual benefits of illness according to the Prophet's advice to Salman al-Farsi?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, this hadith from the Ahl al-Bayt tradition frames illness not merely as a trial but as a spiritual opportunity for *tazkiyah* (purification) through specific devotional acts. It emphasizes that sincere remembrance (*dhikr*) and supplication during sickness are divinely accepted, while the physical suffering serves to erase minor sins, thereby elevating the believer’s status before death.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 3-224 Muhammad ibn Ali ibn ash-Shah narrated that Abu Hamid quoted Abu Yazid Ahmad ibn Khalid al-Khalidy, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Salih al-Tamimy, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Hatam al-Qat’tan, on the authority of Hammadibn Amr, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB), on the authority of his father (MGB), on the authority of his grandfather (MGB), on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) told Salman al-Farsi, “O Salman!

When you become sick, you gain three things:1- You continually remember God.,2- Your prayers are accepted., and3- All your sins are pardoned due to that ailment. May God give you good health up to the time of your death.
